metadata.question: Between December 2021 and January 2022, was the mean snow cover on Villarrica greater than the 2000 to 2020 average for the same months?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Location: Villarrica Volcano, Chile (point: [-71.93, -39.42]) buffered 12 km.
- Primary dataset: MODIS/061/MOD10A1 and MODIS/061/MYD10A1 (Terra + Aqua daily snow cover). Fallback: 006 versions.
- Periods:
  • Target: 2021-12-01 to 2022-02-01.
  • Baseline: 2000-01-01 to 2020-12-31 filtered to months 12 or 1.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Mask valid snow values only (0–100) in NDSI_Snow_Cover; exclude all other codes (clouds, night, no-decision, fill).

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Valid zero: mean within [0,100] with >0 valid pixels -> proceed to compare.
- C1: If both 061 and 006 collections return size 0 for a period.
- C2: If images exist but valid pixel count after masking is 0.
- C3: If computed mean is null/NaN or outside [0,100].
- D: Catch any runtime/dataset errors and report.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.93, -39.42]).buffer(12000);
    const scale = 1000;

    const targetStart = '2021-12-01';
    const targetEnd = '2022-02-01';

    const baseStart = '2000-01-01';
    const baseEnd = '2020-12-31';

    // 2. Helper: build snow collections (Terra + Aqua), with fallback
    function prep(img) {
      const b = img.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover');
      const mask = b.gte(0).and(b.lte(100));
      return b.updateMask(mask).toFloat();
    }
    function monthFilterDecJan(ic) {
      return ic.filter(ee.Filter.or(
        ee.Filter.calendarRange(12, 12, 'month'),
        ee.Filter.calendarRange(1, 1, 'month')
      ));
    }
    function buildCollection(start, end, filterDecJan) {
      let ic061 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD10A1').filterDate(start, end)
        .merge(ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD10A1').filterDate(start, end));
      if (filterDecJan) ic061 = monthFilterDecJan(ic061);
      ic061 = ic061.map(prep);

      // Check size; if zero, try 006 fallback
      const size061 = ic061.size().getInfo();
      if (size061 > 0) {
        return { ic: ic061, used: 'C061', size: size061 };
      }
      let ic006 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1').filterDate(start, end)
        .merge(ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MYD10A1').filterDate(start, end));
      if (filterDecJan) ic006 = monthFilterDecJan(ic006);
      ic006 = ic006.map(prep);
      const size006 = ic006.size().getInfo();
      return { ic: ic006, used: 'C006', size: size006 };
    }

    // Build collections and immediate size checks
    const target = buildCollection(targetStart, targetEnd, false);
    const baseline = buildCollection(baseStart, baseEnd, true);

    if (target.size === 0 || baseline.size === 0) {
      console.log(`Target Images: ${target.size} [${target.used}]`);
      console.log(`Baseline Images: ${baseline.size} [${baseline.used}]`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing: mean composite per period
    const targetImg = target.ic.mean();
    const baselineImg = baseline.ic.mean();

    // 4. Stats function
    function statsFor(img) {
      const meanDict = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const cntDict = img.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const totalDict = ee.Image(1).rename('const').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });

      const mean = meanDict.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo();
      const validCount = cntDict.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover').getInfo();
      const total = totalDict.get('const').getInfo();

      return {
        mean: mean,
        validCount: validCount || 0,
        total: total || 0,
        validPct: (validCount && total) ? (100 * validCount / total) : 0
      };
    }

    const tStats = statsFor(targetImg);
    const bStats = statsFor(baselineImg);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    // C2: No valid pixels after masking
    if ((tStats.validCount === 0) || (bStats.validCount === 0)) {
      console.log(`Target Images: ${target.size} [${target.used}]`);
      console.log(`Baseline Images: ${baseline.size} [${baseline.used}]`);
      console.log(`Target valid px: ${tStats.validCount}/${tStats.total} (${tStats.validPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
      console.log(`Baseline valid px: ${bStats.validCount}/${bStats.total} (${bStats.validPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // C3: invalid means
    function invalid(v) {
      return (v === null || Number.isNaN(v) || v < 0 || v > 100);
    }
    if (invalid(tStats.mean) || invalid(bStats.mean)) {
      console.log(`Target mean: ${tStats.mean}, Baseline mean: ${bStats.mean}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Evidence (concise)
    console.log('Area: Villarrica (-39.42,-71.93), buffer 12km, scale 1000m');
    console.log(`Target (2021-12 to 2022-01) Images: ${target.size} [${target.used}]`);
    console.log(`Baseline (2000-2020, Dec/Jan) Images: ${baseline.size} [${baseline.used}]`);
    console.log(`Target valid px: ${tStats.validCount}/${tStats.total} (${tStats.validPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`Baseline valid px: ${bStats.validCount}/${bStats.total} (${bStats.validPct.toFixed(1)}%)`);
    console.log(`Mean snow cover (%): Target=${tStats.mean.toFixed(2)}, Baseline=${bStats.mean.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`Difference (Target - Baseline): ${(tStats.mean - bStats.mean).toFixed(2)} %`);

    // Final decision
    const answer = (tStats.mean > bStats.mean) ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error:', err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
